pair.title: Connect DCH-S220
pair.subtitle: Enter the siren's local IP address, username and six-digit PIN.
pair.guide_subtitle: Prepare the siren before adding it to Homey.
pair.step1_text: Plug the DCH-S220 into a wall outlet near your Wi-Fi router.
pair.step2_text: Start WPS on the router, then press the siren's WPS button. Wait for it to join the 2.4 GHz network.
pair.step3_title: 3. Find and reserve the IP address
pair.step3_text: Open the router's client list and find the DCH-S220 or its MAC address. Reserve the address so it does not change.
pair.step4_text: The six-digit PIN and MAC address are printed on the label on the back of the siren.
pair.warning_text: The siren can reach 100 dB. Sound is only played when you start a sound test or a Flow yourself.
pair.trouble_title: If the siren cannot be found
pair.trouble_text: Check that Homey and the siren are on the same local network, client isolation is disabled and the IP address responds.
